findings.title: audit_logs BEFORE UPDATE trigger — invariant stronger than CLAUDE.md §8 mandate
findings.description: CLAUDE.md §8 mandates BEFORE DELETE trigger on audit_logs. Actual DB has BOTH BEFORE DELETE (audit_logs_no_delete) AND BEFORE UPDATE (audit_logs_no_update). UPDATE protection enforces full append-only-and-immutable (not just append-only).
findings.action: Update CLAUDE.md §8 to document BEFORE UPDATE trigger as part of NF525 invariant arsenal.

findings.title: 10 production boot guards, not 5
findings.description: CLAUDE.md §8 enumerates 5 forbidden conditions (POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE, IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED, APP_DEBUG, APP_URL, CACHE_DRIVER). AppServiceProvider.php has 10 throw new \RuntimeException blocks for: those 5 + PAYMENT_BYPASS_MODE + PRINTING_BYPASS_MODE + LOYALTY_QR_SECRET + BROADCAST_DRIVER + QUEUE_CONNECTION.
findings.action: Update CLAUDE.md §8 to enumerate all 10 boot guards.

findings.title: fiscal_sequence_no gaps in dev DB (29-32, 35) are TRUNCATE residue, not allocation bugs
findings.description: branch=1 has 2 gaps in fiscal_sequence_no (28→33 missing 29-32; 34→36 missing 35). audit_logs retains counter_payment_confirmed events for the underlying orders (128, 129, 130, 134), but the orders rows themselves were TRUNCATEd via FreshOrderSeed dev command. The triple-defense allocation pattern at FiscalSequenceService:66-104 (Cache::lock + transaction + lockForUpdate + withTrashed) is intact for runtime.
findings.action: Document this dev-data shape in PROJECT_BRAIN — current dev DB has gap-bearing fsn series due to dev seeds. Production NEVER reaches this state (FreshOrderSeed.php:21-24 environment guard).

findings.title: Ansible REVOKE list documentation imprecision
findings.description: CLAUDE.md §8 states 'GRANT-level REVOKE on audit_logs + z_reports' mitigates TRUNCATE bypass. Actual implementation at deploy/ansible/site.yml:59-75 only revokes DROP and ALTER (which transitively blocks TRUNCATE per MySQL semantics — TRUNCATE requires DROP). DELETE remains GRANTed for normal app operation; defense-in-depth provided by BEFORE DELETE trigger.
findings.action: Either (a) update CLAUDE.md §8 to specify 'REVOKE DROP, ALTER' (current implementation) OR (b) explicitly REVOKE TRUNCATE on supported MySQL versions. (a) is sufficient — TRUNCATE is blocked transitively.
findings.fiscal_risk: LOW — runtime invariant holds; documentation drift only

findings.title: z_reports table empty in dev — close path untested in this DB
findings.description: Zero rows in z_reports despite 38 fiscal_sequence_no allocations. Schema + service present, no close events triggered. This is expected for dev — production requires daily close to populate.
findings.action: Ensure operator playbook includes 'php artisan z-report:close' (or equivalent) at end-of-day. Document in deploy/ runbooks.

findings.title: 6-year retention partitioning + archive policy not yet codified
findings.description: At 1000 orders/day projected (peak Le Cayenne ~150 orders/day per memory), audit_logs grows to ~10.95M rows / 5.5 GB over 6 years. MySQL handles this fine on single-box with proper indexes, but partition pruning would dramatically improve query performance. No PARTITION BY RANGE(created_at) defined on audit_logs/z_reports migrations.
findings.action: V1.0.X backlog — add monthly partition migration + cold-archive policy for rows >2 years.
findings.fiscal_risk: FUTURE OPERATIONAL — not blocking V1 LOCAL
